title: Spectacular Spain Memories with Picster
text:
We had an amazing photo-shoot experience with the Picster team during our Spain trip in November 2025. This was our first time booking a professional photo shoot, and Picster truly exceeded our expectations.

Our first session was in Madrid, scheduled for 30 minutes. Our photographer, Josel, was both punctual and highly professional. She guided us to hidden photo spots around the city and captured beautiful shots. She also suggested poses and shared interesting insights about the places we visited during the shoot. title: Read the Fine Print  Before You Book
text:
I would like to share my experience so that other travelers can make an informed decision.

The photo session itself was enjoyable, and the photographers were friendly. However, what happened afterward was very disappointing.

I purchased a package that included 20 photos. Later, I was offered the opportunity to leave a Tripadvisor review in exchange for access to download the remaining photos from my session. I completed the review as requested.
